column1: This configuration defines how discounts appear on quotations. If the discount is calculated separately, it appears on quotation lines with a discounted unit price. column1: This configuration enables the pricing scale feature. A pricing scale in AOS allows creating calculation rules to evaluate the field of an object (an order line, an order, a quotation, a stock move, etc.) based on parameters (called pricing rule).

column1: This is the company name that identifies the business or the activity and that will be visible to the general public.
